desc.zh: 从三项技能的组队实验，推导按技能覆盖保存最小团队的动态规划。
desc.en: Build a tiny team, then derive dynamic programming over skill coverage.

complexity: O(L + n m 2^m) time; O(m 2^m + m) auxiliary space, with m skills, n people, L input skill entries

concepts.name: Minimum team by exact skill coverage
concepts.description: Derive shortest-team DP using frozen before-round coverage states.

concepts.name: Coverage dominance counterexample
concepts.description: Explain why largest-skill greedy and equal-size coverage pruning fail.
